title: A Long Carry
summary: Letty Bargain wants 2 sacks of salt carried from the far end of Harrowgate to Dena Harker at the caravan stage before the guild audit.
offer_text: "The sacks of salt are by my door and Dena Harker is waiting at the caravan stage. It is a long walk and I have a bad knee. Take them over before the guild audit."

objectives.text: Take 2 sacks of salt from outside Letty's door
Hand the sacks of salt to Dena Harker
